text: Complete: SearchlightClassifierScanner provides direct SWIFT centroid and ridge LDA feature-set scanners over the existing RoiOutcome/MvpaResult contract, with fallback for non-specialized classifiers. Reference-equivalence tests compare stored probabilities against MvpaEngine for SWIFT and ridge LDA, preserve failures, and document allocation behavior. Verified with sbt mvpaJVM/test mvpaJS/test, sbt compileAll, and sbt testAll.
